units.source_text: ……但是，现在我看见母亲几乎大半个身心都沉浸在母性的悲叹之中，就突然感到我自由了。

en.t: ...But now, seeing that my mother had almost wholly sunk, body and soul, into maternal grief, I suddenly felt that I was free.

units.source_text: 为什么会如此，我也不知道。

en.t: Why this should have been so, I do not know either.

units.source_text: 我只是感到母亲已经绝对不能威胁我了。

en.t: I only felt that my mother could no longer threaten me in any way.
